title: Rocket equation
description: Change fuel_mass or isp to explore unit-aware delta-v.

title: Hello, Graphcal
description: Change the masses and see reactive dependencies update.

title: Dimensions and units
description: Try a different mass unit; incompatible dimensions produce diagnostics.

title: Structured orbital transfer
description: Change target_alt; expand the transfer result and compare travel time.

title: Reusable functions
description: Explore typed functions and DAG instances for orbital calculations.

title: Indexed maneuvers
description: Change a maneuver; compare sums, maximums, and cumulative delta-v.

title: Engineering assertions
description: Raise payload above capacity to see a failing engineering constraint.

title: Exponential decay plot
description: Change decay_rate or initial_value to reshape the chart.

title: Can adding weight reduce vibration?
description: At 3.18 Hz, change mass from 10 kg to 15 kg. Then try 2.6 Hz: the heavier machine becomes worse.

title: Two loudspeakers: louder, or silence?
description: Change relative_phase from 0 deg to 180 deg to silence the centerline, then move the listener sideways.

title: Can a faster signal look slower?
description: Keep sampling_rate at 10 Hz. Compare signal frequencies of 1, 6, 9, and 10 Hz: different signals share samples.

title: One equation, then chaos
description: Try growth values 2.8, 3.2, 3.5, 3.9, and 3.83. Look beyond generation 40 for cycles, chaos, and returning order.

title: Why is the queue suddenly enormous?
description: Raise arrival_rate from 48/h to 57/h: mean waiting jumps from 4 to 19 min. At 60/h, no finite steady-state mean exists.

title: More aggressive control can make things worse
description: At gain = 4 Hz, change delay_steps from 0 to 10. Reduce gain to 2 Hz to turn growing oscillations into decaying ones.
